display_duration.description: Seconds per turn on the panel (screens alternate every page_seconds)

poll_seconds.description: Seconds between polls of Home Assistant

events.description: Burst when the front door opens or unlocks, or you arrive home

interrupt.description: Take over the panel for an event instead of waiting for the plugin's turn

event_seconds.description: How long an event burst stays up

test_mode.description: Play a made-up day of events (no polling). Turn off afterwards.

screens.description: Screens of up to four tiles each. Defaults match this house; see the README for tile types.

entity.description: lock, opening, presence and temp tiles

entities.description: safe tiles: alarm binary_sensors; ALARM when any is on

attr.description: temp tiles: read this attribute instead of the state (e.g. current_temperature)

state.description: count tiles: the state to count (default on)
